name: Sample · Annapurna Base Camp trek, Nepal
notes: This is a sample plan: edit it into your own, or delete it like any other plan. No dates yet; the round trip takes about 7–10 days, mostly back the same way.

todos.text: Get trekking permits (check the latest permit and guide rules before you go)
Buy travel insurance that covers high-altitude rescue

guide:
## Altitude

- Above 3000 m, don't climb too much in one day; stop and rest if you get a headache or nausea, and go down at once if it gets worse.

## Seasons

- October–November and March–May are generally considered the best months; June–September is monsoon season, with slippery trails and the mountains often hidden.

schedule.text: Day 1: drive from Pokhara to the trailhead and start walking
Last day: back to Pokhara to rest
A stone-built Gurung village; on a clear day you can see Machapuchare (Fishtail)
Then up the Modi Khola valley: Bamboo → Deurali → Machapuchare Base Camp (MBC)
Annapurna Base Camp, about 4130 m; watch the sunrise next morning, then head back down
